hull: Shared across six pantheons; live hero/owner flag
shipConstruction: Immediate at owned coastal town; choose empty adjacent water hex; no new building required
coastalTown: At least one water neighbor of actual town footprint; launch does not make mountains or gates passable.
terrain: Occupied ship moves water-to-water only, cost100 per hex, no road bonus; use hero daily movement budget.
embarkDisembark: Adjacent legal coast/empty friendly-or-neutral ship. Requires at least100 movement; consumes all remaining movement. No free refresh by switching modes.
armyCapacity: One hero with current army; normal existing stack limit. No separate creature headcount limit.
heroFlag: Use hero’s current player color and existing banner shape. Hide mounted avatar; show hero portrait/name on inspect. Empty ship gets neutral owner marker, not a fictitious hero.
combat: Move into adjacent hostile occupied-ship hex to request boarding battle; no remote cannon fire, no sea catapult.
victory: Winner stays on own ship. Attacker victory moves own ship to contested water hex; loser ship removed after transient wreck visual. Defender victory keeps defender position.
defeat: Use existing hero/army defeat persistence; do not leave dead hero aboard. No persistent combat hull HP in this version.
retreat: If existing rules permit retreat, require a deterministic legal unoccupied water destination; hero remains on same ship with existing retreat casualties. No free land teleport. Disable with reason if none.
flyers: May cross water but must land complete footprint on deck/bridge.
normalLandInteraction: Embarked hero cannot claim inland sites/towns or attack shore units directly; must disembark legally.
routePersistence: Store final destination and remaining mixed-mode route across days; pause with embark/disembark confirmation where needed; never re-mark automatically or auto-confirm a battle.
mapSupport: Editor can place empty/occupied ships; random-map generator must test land-water connectivity and coastal starts.
numbers: Proposed starting balance; verify by playtesting.
